formative_worksheets.title: The Coin and Bill Check
formative_worksheets.when_to_use: After Lesson 3, before Lesson 4. Quick mid-unit check (8 min).
formative_worksheets.purpose: Standalone formative check confirming coin and bill identification before comparing.
formative_worksheets.student_learning_goal: I can name coins and bills.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can name coins and bills.
header.character_watermark: Penny the Penguin with a clipboard in the top-right. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

prompts.visual_layout: Three coin icons with name lines under each.

image_placeholders.description: Three coin icons (dime, quarter, loonie) for Grade 1 formative check, B&W line art. Each with name line.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q1_COINS at Prompt 1: keywords name the coins identification task.

prompts.prompt: Match each bill to its colour.
prompts.visual_layout: Three bills with colour lines beside.

image_placeholders.description: Three bills ($5, $10, $20) for Grade 1 formative check, B&W line art. Each with colour line beside.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q2_BILLS at Prompt 2: keywords name the bills colour match task.

prompts.prompt: How are you feeling? Circle the face.

image_placeholders.description: Three round face icons for Grade 1 formative check, B&W line art.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q3_FACES at Prompt 3: keywords name the visual.

formative_worksheets.teacher_notes: Administer between Lesson 3 and Lesson 4. Print one per child.

reflection_sheet.title: My Classroom Market Reflection
reflection_sheet.student_learning_goal: I can think about what I learned this week.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can think about what I learned this week.
header.character_watermark: Penny and Cassie with a Junior Shopper certificate in the top-right. References blueprint.recurring_characters.

prompts.prompt: How do you feel? Circle one.

image_placeholders.description: Three rating ovals for Grade 1 reflection.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_STARS at Prompt 1: keywords name the star rating visual.

prompts.prompt: Did you do these? Circle YES or NO.

image_placeholders.description: A 4-row YES/NO table for Grade 1 reflection.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_YN_TABLE at Prompt 2: keywords name response options.

image_placeholders.description: A bordered rectangle for Grade 1 reflection.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_FAV_BOX at Prompt 3: keywords name the favourite activity focus.

prompts.prompt: The trickiest part for me was...

image_placeholders.description: A bordered rectangle for Grade 1 reflection.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_TRICKY_BOX at Prompt 4: keyword names the trickiest part focus.

prompts.prompt: Next time, I want to try...

image_placeholders.description: A bordered rectangle for Grade 1 reflection.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_NEXT_BOX at Prompt 5: keywords name the next-time focus.
